title: LENS: Replacing LayerNorm and Softmax in Transformers with Learnable Normalization States
abstract: arXiv:2611.20331v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LayerNorm and attention Softmax are critical operations in Transformers. However, they cannot be efficiently mapped to General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) computations on hardware. Therefore, modern hardware accelerator designs, such as NPUs on ASIC/FPGA, consume a large amount of hardware resources or chip area to implement their specific arithmetic units. Building on previous work about LayerNorm, Softmax, and their alternatives, we introduce Learnable Normalization States (LENS), a framework that reformulates LayerNorm as tiny MLPs by abstracting a common structure from related methods and extends this method to Softmax, which moves more of the computation in Transformers to GEMM as a hardware-friendly architecture. We evaluate LENS on image classification with Vision Transformers (ViT) and autoregressive language modeling with Pythia models, including generalization tests on WikiText and LAMBADA. translated_title: LENS：用可学习的归一化状态替换 Transformer 中的 LayerNorm 和 Softmax
translated_abstract: LayerNorm 和注意力 Softmax 是 Transformer 中的关键操作。然而，它们无法高效地映射到硬件上的通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）计算。因此，现代硬件加速器设计（如 ASIC/FPGA 上的 NPU）需要消耗大量硬件资源或芯片面积来实现其专用的算术单元。基于先前关于 LayerNorm、Softmax 及其替代方法的研究工作，我们提出了可学习归一化状态（LENS）框架，该框架通过从相关方法中抽象出共同结构，将 LayerNorm 重新表述为微型 MLP，并将该方法扩展到 Softmax，从而将 Transformer 中更多的计算转移到 GEMM 上，形成一种硬件友好的架构。我们在基于 Vision Transformer (ViT) 的图像分类任务和基于 Pythia 模型的自回归语言建模任务上对 LENS 进行了评估，并在 WikiText 和 LAMBADA 上进行了泛化测试。在这些任务中，LENS 的表现与原始方法相当（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: LENS 框架将 Transformer 中的 LayerNorm 和 Softmax 重新表述为可学习的微型 MLP，把更多计算转化为硬件友好的 GEMM 操作，从而显著降低硬件加速器的资源消耗。
en_tdlr: LENS reformulates LayerNorm and Softmax in Transformers as learnable tiny MLPs, converting more computations into hardware-friendly GEMM operations and thereby significantly reducing hardware resource consumption in accelerators.
